The December 2014 Holotable Set 0 archive distributed the earlier [[Admiral Motti (V) (Virtual Block 1)|Legacy Block 1 face]]. The [[:File:VB1-D-admiralmotti-pre.gif|archived image]] refers to the Virtual Block 4 version of Kuat Drive Yards, matching the badge on the Kuat Drive Yards face packed in the same archive.<ref name="motti-2014-holotable">[http://www.holotable.com/download/downloads/holotable-large_images_postreset.tar.bz2 Holotable post-Reset large-image archive] (December 2014), <code>cards/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/admiralmotti.gif</code>.</ref>

The July 2018 digital face measures 346×486 pixels and has a uniqueness dot in its bottom caption.<ref name="motti-v0-face-2018">[https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Players Committee Holotable Set 9 load], 8 July 2018. [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Dark/large/admiralmotti.gif Exact image].</ref> The July 2022 remaster measures 745×1039 pixels and drops the dot from the bottom caption. It retains the dot next to the title at the top of the card and the same game text. Compare the [[:File:V0-D-admiralmotti-2022-07-31-change-before.png|2018 caption]] and the [[:File:V0-D-admiralmotti-2022-07-31-change-after.png|2022 caption]].
